title: coleus humulopsis
intro: Coleus humulopsis, commonly known as Java cobra's blood, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, relieve digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Coleus humulopsis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Coleus humulopsis include rosmarinic acid, which is a potent antioxidant responsible for many of its therapeutic effects.
